description: Decode a binary or hexadecimal bit-pattern into a specified format. Returns the decimal value and full component breakdown.

bits.description: Bit-pattern as a binary string (e.g. "0100000001001000") or hex string with 0x prefix (e.g. "0x4048").

format.description: Format preset key (e.g. "fp16") or custom format object.

name: decode_bits
title: Decode bits
